title: Norway Wonders | Journey to the Land of Fjords
highlights: Explore Norway’s majestic fjords, where towering cliffs meet serene waters, and uncover the charm of its stunning coastal villages.
Sail with Hurtigruten along Norway’s rugged fjords, vibrant coastal towns, and the serene beauty of the northern seascape.
Embark on a scenic cruise ride from Gudvangen to Flam, where you'll glide past dramatic cliffs, cascading waterfalls, and idyllic fjord views.
Experience a scenic train journey from Bergen to Voss, passing through lush valleys, stunning lakes, and picturesque mountain landscapes.
Discover Flåm Valley, where winding rivers and lush forests frame stunning mountain views, creating a stunning retreat in Norway’s beauty.
overview:
About the tour:
Norway is a place that came straight out of an artist's imagination, with breathtaking fjords, stunning mountain ranges, and rugged coastline, this scenic place will surely take your breath away. This 7-day tour to this Nordic Country begins and ends in the capital city, Oslo and takes you on a scenic Hurtigruten coastal cruise from Trondheim, revealing breathtaking vistas among the vast fjords and mountains. Your astonishment wouldn't cease here, wait till you experience one of the most beautiful train journeys in the world, from Aurlandsfjord, a branch of the Sognefjord, up to the high mountains at Myrdal station. This classic Norway tour package is indeed a wonderful treat for nature lovers that give you an out-of-the-ordinary experience, to ride the beautiful rails, sail amidst the fjords and enjoy Norwegian culture in its most beautiful cities.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Oslo | Leisure Day
days.desc: Welcome to Norway! Upon arrival at Oslo Airport, get transferred to your hotel. Check in and spend your time at leisure. You can visit Royal Palace, a neoclassical marvel that serves as the Norwegian monarch’s residence. Or, visit Oslo City Hall, famed for its striking architecture and the Nobel Peace Prize ceremony. You can also marvel at the Oslo Opera House’s unique sloping roof, offering stunning city and fjord views. Afterward, return to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Scenic Train from Oslo to Trondheim
days.desc: In the morning, check out and get driven to Oslo train station. Next, board your train to Trondheim. Enjoy a breathtaking journey through Gudbrandsdalen Valley and the Dovre Mountain Plateau. Spot wild musk oxen along the way as you descend into Trondheim. Upon arrival, get driven to the hotel. Check in and rest for some time. Later, you can explore Trondheim’s charming Bakklandet district, visit the impressive Nidaros Cathedral, or discover the Ringve Museum. Afterward, return to your hotel.

items.title: Check-in at Deluxe hotel
items.hotel: Radisson Blu Royal Garden Hotel, Trondheim

days.title: Embark on Hurtigruten Cruise
days.desc: Check out & get driven to the Trondheim harbour. Start your day by boarding your Hurtigruten cruise sailing past the island sceneries. Check in & arrive at your first stop, Kristiansund, visit the Bacalao Capital & walk around the old town's cobblestone streets. Then, climb to the Varden viewpoint, watchtower for panoramic views. Later continue to Molde, with breathtaking views of the Romsdal Alps. Finally, arrive at your midnight stop in Ålesund for an overnight stay in a cruise cabin.

days.title: Arrival in Bergen | A Scenic Journey
days.desc: Today, continue your journey ahead while catching a glimpse of Nordfjord and the massive Jostedal Glacier. Next, arrive in Florø to see Stabben Lighthouse, a photographer's delight. Then, sail across the Sognefjord, Norway's longest fjord, before reaching Bergen. Upon arrival at Bergen, disembark and get driven to your hotel. Check in and rest for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Flam
days.desc: In the morning, check out and get on a journey to experience the Western Norway. You’ll head to the Bergen station to board your train to Voss. Upon arrival, take a thrilling bus ride to Gudvangen and later hop on a scenic 2-hour fjord cruise to Flåm, where you'll sail through the narrowest arm of the Sognefjord, the Nærøyfjord with the views of the towering peaks, cascading waterfalls, and the small farms that dot the mountainsides. Then, sail up Aurlandsfjord to Flåm, for an overnight stay.

items.title: Scenic Train Journey from Bergen to Voss
Transfer in AC Shuttle Bus

items.title: Scenic Cruise Ride From Gudvangen to Flam

days.title: The Flam Railway Experience | Transfer to Oslo
days.desc: Post check out, get driven to Flam Railway Station. Experience the steepest and scenic train ride in the world, The Flam Railway soaking in the views of rushing rivers, roaring waterfalls, and snow-capped peaks. Then, take the Bergensbanen train at Myrdal station enjoying Norway's mountainous rooftops and the villages of Geilo and Gol. Upon arrival in Oslo, get transferred to your hotel. Check in for an overnight stay.

items.title: Scenic Train Journey from Flam to Myrdal

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, check out from your hotel and get transferred to the Oslo airport. Next, board your flight back to home. This marks the end of your trip.
